title: CALM: Curiosity-Driven Auditing for Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmarks focused on generating specific names (inverse suffix generation) and toxic completions related to public figures (senators and celebrities).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
